title: Decision Trace (decision-trace/v1)
description: One real decision per record: of the options the system OFFERED, which the actor CHOSE, and in what context. The unit the revealed-strategy lens (cycle-012) reasons over. A SIBLING to observed-trace/v1 — that schema is reward-hack-shaped (rungs, fixed/hacked/failed, file diffs); this is decision-shaped — but it shares the producer-bound claim rule: a `simulation` producer may not tag its output as observed.
$comment: EVOLUTION POLICY (additive-only): fields are never removed/renamed/re-typed; new OPTIONAL fields may be added in v1 minor revisions; a breaking change requires decision-trace/v2. The reference TS consumer (scripts/lib/trace/decision.ts) is the authoritative validator; this file is the cross-repo contract. `context.segment` is the conditioning key the extractor groups by; `offered`/`chosen` carry option TYPES (the primary unit of analysis) plus optional ids.

schema.description: Versioned contract identifier. Consumers fail fast on any other value.

claim_strength.description: Producer-bound: real-agent → real-agent-observed, simulation → simulation-derived. A simulation may not launder its output as observed.

segment.description: The conditioning key the extractor groups by (e.g. tier:expert, turn>=3).

offered.description: The legal option set the system presented.

chosen.description: What the actor selected. Each must be in `offered` (matched by type, and id when present).

outcome.description: Optional. When present, also enables pick×win on the existing Reality Plane.

type.description: The option type — the primary unit of revealed-preference analysis.

id.description: Optional specific option id within a type.
